overview: Germany is a country in Central Europe and the most populous member of the European Union. Its capital and largest city is Berlin. After the Second World War, Germany was divided into West and East Germany; the Berlin Wall fell in 1989 and the country reunited in 1990. Germany is a federal republic of 16 states and has one of the largest economies in the world.

geography.text: Germany's landscape rises from north to south. The north is a flat plain facing the North Sea and the Baltic Sea. The centre has wooded hills and low mountains, and in the far south the Alps rise along the border with Austria, where the Zugspitze is the country's highest peak. Its great rivers include the Rhine, the Elbe and the Danube.

history.text: For centuries the German lands were split into hundreds of states within the Holy Roman Empire. Germany was unified in 1871. After defeat in the First World War, the Nazis took power in 1933, started the Second World War and carried out the Holocaust. Divided after 1945 into West and East Germany, the country was reunited in 1990.

events.title: The Reformation
events.text: Martin Luther's protest against the Church begins the Protestant Reformation.

events.title: Unification
events.text: The German states unite as the German Empire.

events.title: Nazis take power
events.text: Adolf Hitler becomes chancellor and creates a dictatorship.

events.title: Defeat and division
events.text: Germany is defeated and divided by the Allied powers.

events.title: Berlin Wall
events.text: East Germany builds a wall dividing Berlin.

events.title: Reunification
events.text: East and West Germany are reunited.
